facts.content: Use British English spelling (colour, favourite, centre, organise, defence).
Never use betting language: no odds, bets, wagers, tips, punts or bookmakers.
Match previews: keep the body to at most 120 words.
Match previews: mention the format (T20) in the opening sentence and give the start time with its time zone, as in "19:30 IST".
Match previews: a measured, knowledgeable tone; no hype words such as 'epic' or 'mouth-watering'.
Club site header menu order: Home, News, Fixtures, Squad, Standings, Videos, Photos.
Club site: when the club has a cricket team, give it Fixtures, Squad, Standings and Statistics pages, with the standard slugs.
Club site: add a Fan Zone page only when the brief asks for one.
